title: OpenAI Hires Former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll to Lead Defense AI Strategy
summary:
The generative AI company has appointed Dan Driscoll to a new leadership position focused on integrating its technology into the defense infrastructure of the U.S. and its allies. Driscoll joins the firm as senior counselor for national security modernization, where he will oversee the expansion of artificial intelligence adoption across military and government institutions.

The hiring follows a deal between OpenAI and the U.S. government to bring its models into classified Pentagon environments, a move that occurred after the military's talks with rival developer Anthropic ended without an agreement. Driscoll is an Iraq War veteran and associate of Vice President JD Vance who previously advocated for the acceleration of military tech before resigning his post due to friction with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

OPENAI HIRES FORMER U.S. ARMY SECRETARY: FT

Dan Driscoll will join OpenAI as senior counselor for national security modernization, helping the company expand AI adoption across U.S. and allied defense institutions.

An Iraq War veteran and close friend of Vice President JD Vance, Driscoll previously pushed to accelerate military technology adoption before resigning amid tensions with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

The appointment follows OpenAI's recent agreement to deploy its AI models in classified Pentagon environments after the military's negotiations with Anthropic broke down.
